messages:
anya: FYI — I'm opening a small docs hotfix to add the status page link + a short workaround for the token-refresh flakiness we saw in the outage earlier.

mike: thanks. can you paste the status page url and the exact wording you plan to add? need to check legal on phrasing for 'known issue'. :eyes:

anya: status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-11-token-refresh
Proposal: "Workaround: If you see 401s during long-running streams, call the token refresh endpoint before opening the next stream. See curl example below. This is a temporary mitigation; engineering is rolling a permanent fix."

olivia: short + factual works. please avoid 'outage' in the docs page title though — use 'incident' or 'service disruption' in body per comms guidance.

anya: good call. update: wording changed to: "If you observe intermittent 401s on long-lived streams after the incident, call the token refresh endpoint as a temporary mitigation."

sam: do we need a code snippet for SDK users as well as curl? We should show both JS and curl to reduce support tickets.

anya: yep — adding both. JS snippet will be minimal: `await client.auth.refreshToken()` and mention to re-open stream after refresh. curl block below for ops folks: 
```
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh 
  -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"REPLACE_ME"}'
```

mike: QA for phrasing + CI note: we need to ensure the docs preview passes the linter and that the snippets render. Also mark this as hotfix to get merged before the next nightly deploy.

anya: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123 — includes md update + snippet + meta tag `hotfix: incident-2026-11-token-refresh`. Docs preview link: https://deploy-preview-6123--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh

deploy-bot: build started for PR #6123 — status: running (ci/docs-preview).

olivia: I ran the preview link — snippet looks fine but code fence language was missing for the JS block. small nit.

anya: fixed and pushed. build retriggering.

deploy-bot: build failed for PR #6123 — error: docs-linter/links: broken link to /guides/old-auth-pattern (404).

sam: that broken link is in the same file, I can remove the reference to old-auth-pattern in the hotfix branch — low risk.

anya: removed the broken anchor and pushed. PR now only touches the incident page and snippets. build queued.

deploy-bot: build succeeded for PR #6123 — preview available: https://deploy-preview-6123--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh

mike: I can review in 30m and approve if wording/links are ok. can we target merging within the next hour so support has the doc before they reopen checks?

olivia: +1 for expedited review. just checking legal signoff not required for this text.

anya: noted. @mike @olivia — please approve when you can. Also planning a cherry-pick to `release/2026-11` after merge for the internal KB bump.

mike: reviewed, small nit on punctuation fixed inline, approving now. :thumbsup:

olivia: approved.

deploy-bot: PR #6123 merged into main by anya (docs).

anya: will open a follow-up PR to cherry-pick into `release/2026-11` and add an internal support KB link. Anyone want to add notes to the KB?

sam: I'll add a short runbook entry and paste the sample curl/js there.

statusbot: Incident 2026-11 token-refresh resolved — postmortem pending. Link: https://status.redwood.example/postmortem/2026-11-token-refresh

anya: thanks all. I'll update the internal incident thread with the docs links and mark this as hotfix complete. If anything else pops up, add to the PR comments. :rocket:
